title: WrestleMania XI
summary: This document is about WrestleMania XI, the 11th annual WrestleMania professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF), held on April 2, 1995, at the Hartford Civic Center in Hartford, Connecticut. The document begins with an overview of the event, highlighting its seven matches, including the headline bout between former NFL linebacker Lawrence Taylor and Bam Bam Bigelow (which Taylor won), Diesel's successful WWF Championship defense against Shawn Michaels, Jeff Jarrett's retention of the Intercontinental Championship against Razor Ramon, and Owen Hart and his mystery partner Yokozuna winning the WWF Tag Team Championship from The Smoking Gunns. The Production section covers the background of WrestleMania as the WWF's flagship annual event, celebrity involvement (such as Salt-n-Pepa, Nicholas Turturro, Jonathan Taylor Thomas, and Pamela Anderson), and the storylines/feuds that led to each match, including the Bigelow–Taylor conflict originating at the 1995 Royal Rumble. The Event section provides detailed play-by-play descriptions of all seven matches. The Reception section discusses attendance figures (15,000 fans), pay-per-view buyrates, and mixed critical reviews, with some calling it the worst WrestleMania ever while others credited it with saving the WWF in its rivalry with WCW. The Aftermath section describes subsequent storylines and consequences, such as Diesel and Michaels reuniting, Bigelow's expulsion from the Million Dollar Corporation, the continuation of the Ramon–Jarrett feud, The Undertaker's feud with Kama, Steve McMichael's move to WCW, and the event's home video releases. The document concludes with sections for results, references, and external links.
